mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.run_step (tenant_id, run_id, step_number, state, step_type, fencing_token, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, #{stepNumber}, 'RUNNING'::run_state, #{stepType}, #{fencingToken}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, run_id, step_number) DO UPDATE SET step_type = EXCLUDED.step_type, started_at = EXCLUDED.started_at, completed_at = EXCLUDED.completed_at, fencing_token = EXCLUDED.fencing_token
